title: Aperture
description: One opening a link demands on a building face. The exterior layer must keep this face region clear, carve exactly the cut polygon, and align a floor plate to `base`. Units meters, ground plane XZ, +Y up. Face i of a building is the vertical quad over footprint segment i -> i+1 (outward normal points away from the footprint interior). Face-local frame: origin at footprint vertex i at y=0, U along the segment (meters), V along +Y.

floor.description: advisory floor index from the nominal envelope floor height; -1 = below ground. `base` is authoritative.

u.description: face-local U of the opening center, meters along the segment from vertex i

base.description: absolute y of the opening bottom = min y over the cut polygon. On one building, two aperture bases are either equal or at least 2.5 m apart.

width.description: exact U extent of the cut polygon, meters

height.description: exact V extent of the cut polygon, meters; opening spans [base, base+height]

shape.description: link cross section; a slanted circle cut is the exact ellipse sampled by the polygon

cut.description: Exact closure geometry. polygon is the intersection of the link solid with the face plane, so a diagonal link meeting the face closes with no gap.

polygon.description: world-space [x,y,z] loop; every vertex lies exactly on the face plane

axisDir.description: unit direction of the link axis at this end, pointing away from the building
